name: Min Specs
deliverable: Ruthless reduction of operating protocols down to non-negotiable rules

steps.text: State the purpose the group must achieve and write it where everyone can see it.
List every rule, policy, and habit the group currently treats as required, one per note.
Separate each item into must or should; move everything that is merely customary to the should pile.
Test each must by asking whether breaking it would still let the group achieve the stated purpose.
Discard anything that survives the test only by habit, then publish the small set that remains.

failure: The list stays long because every rule has a defender, and the group leaves with a tidier version of the same bureaucracy.
intervention: Hold up one must and ask: "If we broke this tomorrow, what exactly would fail?" If no one can name the failure, cut it.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
